notes: Strip c, x 4640-6040 with overlap to 4340-6340. Name readings: 'VICTORY' + 'B'LVD' are printed on the NE-SW boulevard (twice, once on each side of the Dana junction), so it is recorded as 'Victory Boulevard' (no 'PARKWAY' seen in this strip). The diagonal continuation of Eugenia east of x 5309 carries only 'AVE'; recorded as Eugenia bending. The curved road along the NW plate edge into Hopkins has no printed name here ('?'); the big spaced 'MITCHELL' south of it (and again at x~6800,y~1000) reads as subdivision lettering. Winding Way = 'WINDING' (x~4450,y~4200) + 'WAY' (x~6100,y~1180), one continuous road; it carries a second line inside its curb lines (from Avondale south past Marion), ignored. Dana's two legs at the Victory junction carry no label in the strip; east leg joins the street printed 'DANA'. 'WOODBURN AVE' at x~6400,y~5150-5650 is lettered across lots 166-172 with no street lines (not a street). Not streets: grey/pink/blue boundary bands (x~4420-4480 beside Glen Lyon, x~5000, x~6300-6340, y~1645), the dashed proposed Victory lines through park lot 22, the '19.36 RD.' dashed line, the creek, sewers, the 16 ft strip SW of Corning's north end, the C.L.&N.
